decisions.fold_order: frame-internal fold to a_f/b_f first; b2 uses b_f^2 to preserve same-frame cross terms
decisions.partial_area_rule: value = A/B over supported area only; four independent area fractions retain lost-area information; no all-subpixel AND
decisions.delivery_threshold: deferred; Gate 2 deliberately does not define a minimum delivery coverage fraction

cpu_exact: constant field full and partial area
single point contribution: one subpixel of one frame
all four support layers independently distinct
invalid weights and frame order rejected
cpu_approx: weighted linear gradient, two frames, unequal weights and areas: a/b/b2/value/n_eff within 1e-15
cuda_parity: single-thread device oracle reproduces CPU result within 1e-12 for a, b, b2, value, n_eff and all four area fractions; support bools identical

forbidden_equations_confirmed_absent: profile support as AND over all internal subpixels
chunk_boundary_criterion: per-native-pixel scalar fold has no chunking; chunk- and tile-boundary invariance is already proven at enumeration level by Gate-1 stripe tests and remains a Gate-6 acceptance criterion for the batch fold kernel
carried_forward_to_later_gates: Gate 3 must supply estimator_b per frame/subpixel or document the fallback mapping estimator_b = source_b
the production batch fold kernel is Gate 6 scope; the single-thread CUDA path is a parity oracle only
confidence may consume the four area fractions; delivery thresholds are undecided
all four profiles reuse this algebra with their own a/b denominators
